method: Primary comparisons alternate before/after/Node order, three warmups, nine samples per session, two sessions. CPU phases use separate instrumented binaries; wall medians cannot be reconstructed by adding phase medians. Before is the compiler and application source retained before this optimization pass, not the older pre-data-optimization compiler.
scope: Native JSON and small exact-decimal runtime, application report loop, native prepared-report admission/response framing. Report service includes host preparation, actual inline/worker selection, result validation and sorting. Database/network latency excluded. Native selection remains opt-in.
limits: Single Apple M1 interactive host; no confidence intervals or universal ranking. All outliers retained. With 18 samples nearest-rank p95 is the maximum. Initial after p95 was 79.63 ms direct and 327.47 ms service; confirmation after p95 was 29.36 and 47.02 ms. Median reduction claims do not establish a tail-latency guarantee.

validation.fullNativeSuite: passed; release, sanitizer and GC-stress paths included
validation.workerAndRouteFocusedTests: 44 focused tests passed; final 12-case report suite including caller-mutation regression passed

pool.boundary: Ledger AryaWorkerPool.run: V8 size accounting, admission snapshot, worker or JSON-lines transfer, pure report, result delivery. One persistent slot/backend. Three warmups, nine alternating samples/session, two sessions. Event-loop probe follows the original application performance script.

reportService.boundary: Database-free report service: host preparation, actual inline/worker selection, calculation, result validation and sorting. Three warmups, nine samples/session, two sessions. Input generation and oracle checks excluded. Small reports follow the existing inline JavaScript route.
reportService.throughputBoundary: Native pool with eight concurrent 10000-row requests; one warmup and three measured batches per size. Snapshot/admission and result delivery included. Process startup excluded after warmup.

reportServiceConfirmation.boundary: Database-free report service: host preparation, actual inline/worker selection, calculation, result validation and sorting. Three warmups, nine samples/session, two sessions. Input generation and oracle checks excluded. Small reports follow the existing inline JavaScript route.
reportServiceConfirmation.throughputBoundary: Native pool with eight concurrent 10000-row requests; one warmup and three measured batches per size. Snapshot/admission and result delivery included. Process startup excluded after warmup.

jsonIsolated.method: Two sessions, one process per binary/data/session; 3 warmups and 9 samples per process. CPU timing wraps only parse or stringify. Full encoded outputs checked against independent Python expected data, and checked byte-for-byte between binaries. Alternating binary order and data order. Warm filesystem cache. Ordinary host activity. after is the same generated application C with only the JSON codec replaced by the final adaptive-cache implementation.

preparedAdmission.method: Trusted prepared report admission through encoded native write; generic run unchanged. Calculation/process transfer excluded; two sessions, five warmups, 21 retained samples each, alternating implementation order.
